content: चयः [चि-अच्] .²1 An assemblage; collection, multitude, heap, mass; चयस्त्विषामित्यवधारितं पुरा <ls>Śi. 1. 3</ls>; मृदां चयः <ls>U. 2. 7</ls> a lump of clay; कचानां चयः <ls>Bh. 1. 5</ls> a braid of hair; so चमरीचयः <ls>Śi. 4. 60</ls>; कुसुमचय, तुषारचय <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A mound of earth raised to form the foundation of a building. .²3 A mound of earth raised from the ditch of a fort. .²4 A rampart. .²5 The gate of a fort. .²6 A seat, stool. .²7 A pile of buildings, any edifice. .²8 Stacked wood. .²9 A cover or covering. .²10 Arranging or keeping the sacred fire; <ab>cf.</ab> अग्निचय. .²11 The amount by which each term increases, the common increase or difference of the terms (in a progression).
